topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: /auto must fail fast when a phase is executed directly by the orchestrator without spawning the required subagent, and it must emit deterministic reason-code coverage for that violation.
Affected scope is /auto orchestration phase runner, subagent spawn enforcement, and phase role/capability guardrails.
Preserve existing phase-isolation and strict-runtime-proof contracts; do not relax safety checks while adding fail-fast enforcement and diagnostics.
Add regression coverage that proves /auto rejects direct in-orchestrator phase execution and reports required fail-fast reason codes for missing subagent spawn.
Done when orchestrator always spawns required subagents per phase and direct execution path is deterministically blocked with explicit fail-fast reason-code evidence.
